scope: T03 descriptive cohort overview only; no A01 year-comparison estimates, CIs or tests
cohort: T01 adopted English articles, UTC publication years 2018-2025; no minimum words; no deduplication
metadata: metadata-v2.parquet; never use v1 author/organization fields
quantiles: linear interpolation at (n-1)*p, including zeros; DuckDB quantile_cont and independent Python check
2025: partial publication year; October partial; November/December not observed, not zero-population months
figure_ecdf: positive-word articles only, with zero-word counts shown separately; overall tabular statistics include zeros
precision_note: fixed language and sentence calibration are small single-operator reviews, not population accuracy guarantees
